# spyn

> Tools to transform data into "model-less" operable inference objects

- [spyn.utils.color](spyn.utils.color.html.md): Color and colormap utilities for matplotlib-based visualizations.
- [spyn.utils.daf](spyn.utils.daf.html.md): DataFrame helpers: variable-combination completion and cartesian product.
